title: Karyo curation
description: What matters in a model and how it is grouped, without touching the code (docs/MODEL.md, Curation): karyo/curation.json next to the model, applied at build time. Entries name nodes by their stable ids; * in a selector matches any run of characters. An entry that matches nothing is a curation-unresolved warning in the model's checks.

note.description: Prose for people: why the curation is what it is

top.description: Nodes drawn as their own cards (unfolded). Wins over fold

fold.description: Nodes drawn folded into their parent (only nodes that have one)

hide.description: Nodes left out of the model with their relationships; what a recorded run reached is kept (curation-kept)

start.description: What a structure board starts on: one card per group (entered level by level), or every card; default: groups when the board is big (docs/ENGINE.md, Group navigation)

parent.description: The group this one sits in (no circles)

nodes.description: Per node id (or selector): what to show instead of what the code says

selectors.description: Node ids, or globs where * matches any run of characters (orders.db.*)
